tasks.title: Load and validate the content file in build.mjs
acceptance_criteria: `build.mjs` exists at the repo root, is ESM, and imports only `node:` builtins

acceptance_criteria.text: `node build.mjs` with `CONTENT_FILE` pointing at a nonexistent file exits 1, prints exactly one line on stderr naming the problem, and creates no `index.html` in a fresh `OUT_DIR` (covers: REQ-15, REQ-16, REQ-17)

Content file `{not json` and valid-JSON-wrong-shape inputs (`null`, `[]`, `{"name":"x","projects":"y"}`) each exit 1 with one stderr line built from a fixed prefix, not raw `err.message` (covers: REQ-15, REQ-16, REQ-17)
Valid JSON with `name` missing, empty or non-string exits 1 with one stderr line naming `name` and writes nothing (covers: REQ-18)
A valid content file with `name`, `tagline`, `about`, `projects[{title,summary,url}]`, `contact{email}` is accepted; absent `projects` is treated as empty (covers: REQ-4)

tasks.title: Render the page layout with escaping and inline CSS

acceptance_criteria.text: Rendered HTML has CSS inside a `<style>` element and no `<script>` element or external resource (covers: REQ-2, REQ-3, REQ-22)
Rendered HTML has exactly one `<h1>` containing the name, the tagline directly after it, then About, Projects, Contact sections in that order (covers: REQ-5, REQ-6)
Each project renders as one card, in array order, and its title is an `<a href>` to its url when the url is an allowed http(s) url (covers: REQ-7, REQ-8)
Contact section renders a `mailto:` link with the escaped email (covers: REQ-9)
All content text and attribute values are escaped for `& < > " '` with `&` first; a title `Rock & Roll` appears as `<b>Rock & Roll</b>` (covers: REQ-14)

tasks.title: Render the project edge cases

acceptance_criteria.text: A project with no `url` renders its title as plain text; the output contains no `href="#"` and no `href=""` (covers: REQ-11)

acceptance_criteria: A project whose url scheme is not http or https (for example `javascript:`) renders its title as plain text, never as an anchor

acceptance_criteria.text: Zero or absent projects renders the sentence "Projects are coming soon." in the Projects section (covers: REQ-12)
Zero projects renders no `<ul>`, `<ol>` or `<li>` in the Projects section (covers: REQ-13)

tasks.title: Write dist/index.html deterministically with env overrides

acceptance_criteria.text: `node build.mjs` with defaults reads `content.json` and writes a single `dist/index.html` (covers: REQ-1, REQ-24)
`CONTENT_FILE` overrides the input path and `OUT_DIR` the output dir, writing `<OUT_DIR>/index.html`; the default `dist/` is untouched in that case (covers: REQ-25)
Running the build twice against the same content produces byte-identical files; the source uses no `Date` and no `Math.random` (covers: REQ-19)
`build.mjs` contains no write to the content file path (covers: REQ-23)
`build.mjs` imports only `node:` builtins and makes no network call (covers: REQ-20, REQ-21)

tasks.title: Add a starter content.json
acceptance_criteria: `content.json` exists at the repo root and passes the validation in `build.mjs`
`content.json` has a name, tagline, about, one project with a url, one project without a url, and a contact email

tasks.title: Write the node --test suite

acceptance_criteria.text: `node --test` exits 0 with a test file that spawns `node build.mjs` against throwaway content files and asserts on HTML text, no browser (covers: REQ-26)

acceptance_criteria: Tests cover the Test Surface rows of both use cases: determinism, escaping, url-less project, zero projects, layout order, env overrides, and each failure code with one stderr line and a fresh `OUT_DIR` holding no `index.html`
Every test runs `node build.mjs` with `CONTENT_FILE` and `OUT_DIR` pointing at temp dirs, and one test asserts the real `content.json` hash is unchanged
